verdicts.reason: A splits the layout sensibly for the wide format, with a large bottle on the left and a strong headline/CTA stack on the right. However, the bottle is cropped at the bottom edge, 'WEEKEND ONLY' has moved from an eyebrow above the headline to below the body copy (reading order changed), and '20% off' sits tight to the right edge. B shrinks the headline and runs the body copy as one long line across the circle. It also shrinks the bottle into a tiny floating object stacked directly on a small centred CTA, leaving the bottom-left and the circle as dead space, so the hierarchy is weak and the product is trivialised.
